# `WireEdgeGroupIn`

**Kind:** class

**Source:** `src/graphrefly/_wire_facade.py:168`

## Signature

```python
WireEdgeGroupIn(gate: Node[Any], inbound: Mapping[str, Node[bytes]], issues: Node[WireEdgeGroupIssue])
```

## Description

The receiver side of a wire edge group: its gate, one inbound node per edge, and
its issues node (drops, gaps and refusals, as values).
